elements.id-string-10: A notion of the limit spectral measure of a metric triple (i.e., a metric measure space) is defined.If the metric is square integrable, then the limit spectral measureis deterministic and coinsides with the spectrum of the integraloperator in $L^2(\mu)$ with kernel $\rho$.
elements.id-string-11: We construct an examplein which there is no deterministic spectral measure.
